$comment: Ferns (tools/content/env/plants.mjs fernMesh). Ground cover with no collision that conceals like a bush (sim/match.ts `hides`: radius half the smaller footprint side, the full height; at the 0.9 m of the Kenney fern it replaces, scale 1.62, it hides a crouched player), grown by the terrain's plants brush (packages/client/src/foliage.ts) and placeable as a prop. 5–7 fronds, each the leaves atlas' frond picture on a card bent along an arch (env.leaf, alpha-tested). One level of detail. The tree fern (env.fern.tree_fern, Environment Phase 5) is a tree made by the palm generator (tools/content/env/palm.mjs, `frondCards`): a short trunk that stops everything, fern fronds overhead, levels of detail and a stand-in like the palms.

notes.1: First version: replaces the Kenney ferns, low plants and small bushes the plants brush grew (owner, 2026-11-05).
notes.2: Conceals (owner, 2026-11-05: it replaces the Kenney fern, which hid players from bots): a cylinder from its bounds, the rule bushes follow, so its role is cover. Shape and size unchanged.

notes.1: First version (Environment Phase 5, the jungle set, 2026-11-18): a short fibrous trunk under a crown of arching fern fronds, a skirt of dead fronds; the palm generator with fern fronds.
